gaps.explanation: Schedule is 200 above the statement. The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p8) prints Local 105,393 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 989,289), which counts the General Fund sale of assets 200 as a receipt. The governmental funds statement (p4) and the General Fund combining statement (p5, General Fund column) print Local 105,193 / 105,235 and show the 200 as 'Sale of assets' under other financing sources. 105,393 - 105,193 = 200 = gap. Both printed totals stand (budget schedule 989,289 vs combining 989,089); no detail fix.

Schedule is 35,182 above the statement. The statement (p4) General Fund column prints transfers out (170,090) and no transfers in, because transfers among the General Fund sub-funds are netted. The General Fund combining statement (p5) prints them gross: Library Fund transfers in 30,842 + Institutions Fund transfers in 4,340 = 35,182 (Total General Fund transfers in 35,182), and the budget schedule (p8) prints General Fund transfers out (205,272) = 170,090 + 35,182. Detail transfers in = 30,842 + 4,340 + 170,090 (Road, p9) + 20,000 (Road Equipment, p7) = 225,272 = 190,090 + 35,182. Gross intra-fund transfers; no fix.

Schedule is 35,182 above the statement. Detail transfers out = General Fund (205,272) (p8) + Road Fund (20,000) (p9) = 225,272. The statement (p4) prints General Fund transfers out (170,090); the extra 35,182 are the General Fund's transfers to its own Library (30,842) and Institutions (4,340) sub-funds, printed gross on the combining statement p5 (Total General Fund transfers in 35,182 / out 205,272) and netted on p4. No fix.
